page.overview:
What is Celestial Toymaker?

The Celestial Toymaker is a Great Old One in the fictional universe of Doctor Who, created by the BBC.

From the beginning of the current universe, the Celestial Toymaker has been known as a mischievous spirit. For thousands of millennia he constantly created and destroyed, but eventually got bored with games becoming his new source of amusement. The Celestial Toymaker would ensnare sentient beings, forcing them to play for their freedom in his games. However he rigs his games as he hates losing. Within his pocket dimension, the Celestial Toyroom possesses vast powers, but they are limited by whatever rules he set for that game. He was able to manipulate space and travel through time at will.
